updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.7.7
- Additional updates since last Beta notes:
  - OKB Out Page commands and Auto Browse fixes, No longer needs Auto Browse to issue Page commands Auto browse full rework.
  - OKB Out refined AWACS tab now includes SAM radars that are radiating and active, Also groups AIR, SAM and EWR with sorting by range.(Still requires AWACS to be on task)
  - OKB Out new AID (Aircraft Interface Device) connection. Controls STORES and also the new FUEL data Block with live feed fuel metrics
 - New AH-64D George pilot commands and backend workflow
